lines.zh: 我摆着身子走，一步一晃。
lines.en: I waddle along, swaying with each step.

lines.zh: 湿地上的草被我踩出水。
lines.en: The marsh grass squeezes out water under me.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子看前面的路。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to see the path.
There are six geese in this flock.

lines.zh: 我走在最前面，谁都别挤。
lines.en: I lead; nobody pushes in.
My webbed feet slap the mud.
I know this stretch of water best.
I dip my head and take a bite of grass.
One honk and the marsh turns loud.
Who is lagging at the back?

lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆地走过湿地。
lines.en: I waddle across the wet ground.
This place is damp; I like it.

lines.zh: 我沿着浅水走，不湿羽毛。
lines.en: I walk the shallows to keep my feathers dry.
Keep up, all of you.
These reeds are ours.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，脖子先探出去。
lines.en: Step by step, my neck goes first.
I stand with my neck still stretched.
The water is flat; I look at myself.
Droplets still cling to my feathers.
I tilt my head and listen.
Nobody dares come here.
I settle down and tuck my feet.
The wind rattles the reeds.
I am waiting for one to stray.
A flock-mate calls from far off.
I shake out my wings.
I remember who wronged me.
I hold grudges — don't cross me twice.

lines.zh: 水面上飘着虫子，我懒得管。
lines.en: Insects drift on the water; I cannot be bothered.
I shift my feet and the mud squeezes up.
You have come here again.
I remember what you did last time.
Do not pretend you do not know.
My neck is already lowered.
Backing off now would still work.
Do not turn your back; I hold grudges.
I stare at you and do not step back.
Which way did you come?

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从背后靠近。
lines.en: I dislike being approached from behind.

lines.zh: 我的喙离你的膝盖很近。
lines.en: My beak is very close to your knee.

lines.zh: 我记仇的，这一下记住了。
lines.en: I hold grudges. Noted.
A few feathers lost. Noted.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脖子还伸着。
lines.en: Half a step back, neck still out.

lines.zh: 我炸着毛，脖子伸得更长。
lines.en: My feathers puff; my neck stretches.
Do not think I am soft.
My wings still open.
Blood drips into the mud.
It hurts, and I will not leave.
My mate is watching.
The score is clear now.
Kelp? Hand it over.
I could eat this all day.
Hold your hand higher.
Do not shake; if it drops, I will not pick it up.
Is there a second piece?
I grab it and run for the water.
I will remember your kindness.
The old score is separate.
Give me one more piece.

lines.zh: 你手里的海带还滴着水。
lines.en: The kelp in your hand still drips.
You bumped me; noted.
My wings are spreading.
One step back, now.
Do not step on my webbed feet.
My neck reaches higher than you.
Count that one as my concession.
Your foot is blocking my webbed feet.
You splashed me from head to foot.
My feathers are soaked.
I will remember this.
I have a mate this season.
Do not get ideas about that.

lines.zh: 我的伴就在那丛芦苇里。
lines.en: My mate is in those reeds.

lines.zh: 我们脖颈交缠，水面起皱。
lines.en: Our necks twine; the water wrinkles.
I do not discuss that.
That is a rude question.
I have noted you.
That matter is closed.
Go away.
Do not bring it up again.
I snatch the kelp and shake it twice.
This is mine now.
Seeing it does not help you.
I carry it off to the water's edge.
Can this go in a beak?
Let me try it first.
If it is bad, I still will not give it back.

lines.zh: 你掉的？那是你的运气不好。
lines.en: You dropped it? Bad luck.
People always drop things here.
Let me look for more.
You moved.
Then it is not my fault.
My neck goes straight; my wings spread.
This marsh is mine.
You should have remembered last time.
My memory is very good.
Where do you think you are running?
My flock holds every water's edge.
You have backed into the mud.
Now you are slow.
I advance on you step by step.
My wings span wider than a man.
You retreat and I follow.
I do not honk; I only stare.
Your footing is soft mud.
Mine is firm.

lines.zh: 你回头看了我一眼，我记下了。
lines.en: You glanced back at me — noted.
There is no way out.
I lower my neck.
This is about to start.
I lunge and peck at your leg.
My wings beat at your face.
My neck shoots out and the bill arrives.
This bill has pecked plenty of people.
But I will keep coming.
Kick me and I will remember.

lines.zh: 这片湿地归我，海带也归我。
lines.en: This wetland is mine, and the kelp too.
I spread my wings and charge.
I follow without letting go.
You cannot run fast in this mud.
I step out of the reeds.
My feet slap the water.
This marsh will do nicely.
I stretch my neck and look around.
There are a few more in the water.
They all follow me.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇里钻出来，叫了一声。
lines.en: I push out of the reeds and honk.
Let me see clearly first.
The damp is just right today.
I give my wings a good shake.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的羽毛，一股焦味。
lines.en: Fire singes my feathers; the smell is burnt.
I roll down the bank into the mud.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的嘴，我拼命拍翅。
lines.en: Water fills my bill; I beat my wings hard.
A patch of my feathers is singed.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过翅膀，羽毛散了。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my wing; feathers scatter.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的翅膀一僵。
lines.en: The light stiffens my wings.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，我连叫都没力气。
lines.en: Hungry, I cannot even honk properly.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，羽毛全竖。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and every feather stands.

lines.zh: 脚下的泥没了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The mud is gone and I drop.
